  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  3:15 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  October 16, 2023 / 3:15 PM

IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Lester Friedman; Councilmember Sharona Nazarian; Deputy
  City Manager Staff Keith Sterling; Community Outreach Manager Staff
  Magdalena Davis; Skechers Jarred Dahlerbruch; CMG Worldwide Mark
  Roesler; CMG Worldwide Joey Roesler, Policy and Management Intern
  Winnie Mai

  1) Public Comment

  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item listed on the agenda.

  •  None

  2) Update to a Request for the Use of the City Shield by Skechers
  • Jarred Dahlerbruch from Skechers presented an overview presentation on their
  proposed Beverly Hills collection by Skechers for review. This included logo
  applications, hang tag, packaging, as well as the shoe wear designs.
  • Mark Roesler, CEO of CMG Worldwide and Jared Dahlerbruch from Skechers
  presented to the committee regarding the large international licensing component
  of Skechers and the request for approval of designs to proceed a production.
  • Feedback from Councilmember Sharona Nazarian and Vice Mayor Lester
  Friedman regarding the appropriate use and design of shoes. Presented designs
  were approved.
 Branding and Licensing Committee

Meeting Highlights

  3) Future Agenda Items Discussion

  •  It was suggested to provide samples of the products at the next meeting.
